articles.title: 23andMe inherits lawsuit over 'disturbing' DNA data breach

articles.title: Microsoft Threatens Researcher Over Bug Reports, Triggers Cybersecurity Uproar

articles.title: Zscaler Stock Plunges on Weak Guidance. Investors Were Maybe Right to Worry About an AI Apocalypse.
articles.summary: Microsoft threatens legal action against researcher for exposing Windows bugs, triggering cybersecurity community uproar. Nothing says 'security first' like siccing lawyers on people finding your flaws.
